text: こんな　つまんない　しま　よろこんで　でてって　やるぜ！

structure.jp: こんな　つまんない　しま

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said in a rough, defiant way: 'fine, I'll do it for you'. でてって やる = 'I'll leave, since you ask'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb adds the idea of moving away from here. でていって loses its い in casual speech and becomes でてって = 'going out and away'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes what you say onto the listener. やるぜ = 'I will, so there!'.
